symbol_repair_2026_11_08.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements, and with them any paragraph that held nothing else. cth_convert_sym_v15.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F0BE —, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_08.what_changed: One em dash (Symbol F0BE -> —) restored as new line 1575, in the endnotes' amendment history (table of amending Acts): the "Application, saving and transitional provisions" cell of the Company Law Review Act 1998 row (as the w:tr holding the F0BE sym in C2018C00175.docx shows), a paragraph holding only the symbol, which the first conversion dropped whole. A diff against the first deposit shows no other change. Lines after 1574 move down by one; the subject has no formulas sidecar.
